preconditions.description: The length of the input string s is between 1 and 10^5.
The value of k is between 1 and 26, representing the minimum frequency of characters in the longest substring.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s)
preconditions.description: All characters in the input string s are lowercase letters.

postconditions.expression: return_value == max(len(substring) for substring in substrings_of(s) if all(substring.count(char) >= k for char in set(substring)))
postconditions.description: The output is the length of the longest substring of s where every character appears at least k times.
